description: List all FRC teams ever registered, paginated in groups of 500. Returns full team profiles. Increment page_num starting at 0 until the response is empty to enumerate every team in TBA's database. For lighter payloads use get_teams_simple; for team keys only use get_teams_keys.

page_num.description: Zero-indexed page number for paginated team listings. TBA returns up to 500 teams per page; increment until the response is empty to enumerate all teams.

name: get_teams
